items.question: How does the first moment of intending to go reveal knowledge of the whole path?
premises: A person wishing to go somewhere from home has a first moment of intention.
In that first moment, whatever is to be reached is already present to awareness.
Whatever lies in the middle of that path is also present in that same moment.
items.inference: The initial moment of directed intention implicitly contains knowledge of the destination and the intervening path.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically incomplete and continues into verse 176.
items.plain_english: Just as, in the very first moment when someone wishes to go from home to some place, whatever is to be reached and whatever lies in between are already present in that moment.

items.question: What capacity is revealed even in a single instant for those skilled in grasping details?
premises: Even in the fall of a single instant, a certain attainment can be present.
That attainment is the state of having gained all-knowingness and all-doingness.
This is especially evident for those skilled in unwavering attention to particular details.
items.inference: For experts with steady attention to particulars, a single instant can manifest the powers of omniscience and omnipotence.
uncertainties: The scope of sarvajña-sarvakartṛtva here may be analogical rather than absolute.
items.plain_english: Even in a single instant, those who are skilled in unwaveringly grasping particular details attain, from that very moment, a state of all-knowing and all-doing.

items.question: What level of subtlety can a thoroughly trained ear discern in musical tones?
premises: Intense and sustained practice can refine the organ of hearing.
Musical tones contain inner microtonal components.
A trained listener can detect even slight deficiency or excess in those microtones.
items.inference: Deep training enables perception of extremely fine distinctions within a single tonal field.
uncertainties: The technical term śruti is rendered generally as microtone; its precise musical value is context-dependent.
